backup.cargada: Backup loaded ({{count}} course(s)). Choose the source and target courses.
backup.semCargar: No backup was loaded (or it's empty).
backup.escolleAmbos: Choose the source and target courses.
backup.descartadas: , {{count}} dropped (no matching day at the target).
backup.descAdmin: Copy the whole site or just the courses you pick. A site copy includes the users (files and messages); untick it if you would rather not.
backup.descProfesor: Choose the courses to back up. You can include their students (their work, files and messages).
backup.restaurarDesc: Create the target course with its calendar first. When restoring, what was taught in session 1 goes to session 1 of the new calendar, even if the day changes.
backup.conDatosAlumnado: With student data (same logins) and course data
backup.modoSitio: The whole site (courses, users, files and messages)
backup.restaurarSitioDesc: Puts the server back the way the copy found it: every file returns to its original place, with no date or calendar remapping. It writes over what is there, but never deletes anything created after the copy.
backup.restaurarSitioUsuarios: Restore users too (work, reports and messages)
backup.restaurarSitioAviso: This will overwrite on the server every file the copy contains. Continue?
backup.sitioRestaurado: Site restored: {{courses}} course(s), {{sharedFiles}} shared file(s), {{users}} user(s) and {{userFiles}} user file(s).
backup.restaurarTodosTitulo: Restore every course in the copy
backup.restaurarTodosDesc: Each course comes back exactly as it was (same name, calendar and groups), and is created if it is no longer on the server. It does not touch the enrolment roster, the professors list or the messages.
backup.restaurarTodosUsuarios: Restore the students' sessions and work too
backup.restaurarTodosAviso: This will overwrite the contents of any of those courses already on the server. Continue?
backup.restaurarIntroAdmin: Load a copy's .zip and, depending on what it holds, you will be able to:
backup.restaurarOpcion1: restore one course into another course already created, remapping the dates onto its calendar;
backup.restaurarOpcion2: restore every course in the copy exactly as it was, creating any that no longer exist;
backup.restaurarOpcion3: restore the whole site — only for a whole-site copy — including enrolment, professors and messages.
backup.cargadaSenCursos: ⚠️ This copy holds no courses (it was made with a Tao older than 26.9.11, which left them out): only users, messages and enrolment can be restored. Make a fresh copy to include the courses.
backup.gardadaSitio: Copy saved to {{zip}}. Next to it, {{csv}} holds the enrolment CSV for {{altas}} account(s): you need it to recreate the accounts before restoring, since accounts are not inside the copy.
backup.csvAltasDesc: File Browser accounts are not in the files: they live in its database, and no restore brings them back. A CSV ready for bulk enrolment is saved next to the copy.
backup.csvAltasAviso: Leave it empty and the password column is left blank, to fill in when you restore. Fill it and the CSV carries a credential: keep it where you keep passwords.

calendar.axudaAtaBaleiro: Leave "To" empty for a single day. All rows count as non-teaching days.
